claim: TWO-PROCESS NCCL CAPSULE SUITE BUILT; THE TP2 COLLECTIVE WALL IS AN INTERMITTENT PER-OP HANG, NOT A BROKEN COLLECTIVE. tools/qwen35_nccl_allreduce_capsule.py (two processes, one per simulated GPU on the lane's generated 2-GPU topology, NET/Socket via NCCL_SHM_DISABLE=1, run under --engine sglang --tp 2 --capsule) progressively established: (v1) a 256-float all_reduce COMPLETES on both ranks with identical correct results -- the data-collective machinery fundamentally works under gem5; a later dist.barrier hung and the watchdog's ncclRemoteError killed the run. (v2) with an instrumented sequence, all_reduce #2, a 1-element all_reduce, and the FIRST barrier all return instantly -- the v1 barrier hang did not reproduce; the run then hung at a LATER tail barrier. (v3) a 10-iteration loop of all_reduce + barrier with interleaved .cpu() syncs: ALL TWENTY OPS PASS, both ranks print 'loop completed'. (v4) the first extended collective (all_gather 1024, list API) hung symmetrically. (v5) with discriminators, all_gather tiny(list), all_gather 1024(list), all_gather_into_tensor, and broadcast ALL PASS (0.0-0.1s); the run hung at reduce_scatter (last marker: broadcast ok; no reduce_scatter line). CONCLUSION: every collective type works most of the time; roughly once per capsule run ONE op (varying: barrier, barrier, all_gather, reduce_scatter) deadlocks symmetrically with frozen wavefronts -- an intermittent race hitting a small per-op probability. The SGLang TP2 lane's symmetric freeze at 1618 dispatches is this race hit under the engine's per-layer collective storm (thousands of ops). NEXT: (a) a rate-measuring loop (1000 mixed collectives with per-op timeout) to quantify the probability and test protocol knobs (NCCL_PROTO=Simple/LL128, NCCL_ALGO) for rate change; (b) instrument gem5's host-native read path around NCCL flag buffers for cross-process allocation resolution and visibility (the crash-forensics audit noted memoryInfo's deliberate ambiguity refusal when two live allocations overlap a range -- a refused or stale flag read during a poll window is the candidate mechanism); (c) fix, then rerun the SGLang TP2 lane.
